column2: Why is every critical-care support removed as soon as reserve returns?
column3: Each support has a cost: oxygen injures lung, positive pressure lowers cardiac output, vasopressors impair peripheral flow, dialysis destabilises circulation, sedation prolongs ventilation, devices cause infection and thrombosis.
